title: A CHARGED-OFF loan credits CHARGE_OFF_EXPENSE and debits DEFERRED_INCOME_LIABILITY for a capitalized-income amortization (loan 30 L784: CREDIT account 14 16.48, DEBIT account 23 16.48)
_note: Parity vector transcribing the TWO-LEG journal entry a CAPITALIZED_INCOME_AMORTIZATION transaction posts on a loan that IS CHARGED OFF and NOT fraud, on the Tier-D MNT replay (throwaway tenant `tierd`, currency MNT, 2 minor digits, product LP2_ADV_PYMNT_INTEREST_DAILY_EMI_360_30_INTEREST_RECALC_DAILY_CAPITALIZED_INCOME) at the amortization transaction L784. request.capitalized_income_amortization_journal.portions transcribes the loan read-back's amortization transaction id 784 (externalId babc97d4-8028-48c2-9e58-a95cc41ad7f0, type loanTransactionType.capitalizedIncomeAmortization): interestPortion 16.48 -> "1648" and feeChargesPortion 0 -> "0" minor units. The loan read-back carries a NON-REVERSED chargeOff transaction id 783 (externalId 7f43c40c-b9cf-4569-959c-aac470cc5651) with a LOWER id and NO charge-off reason, so request...charged_off is true and request...fraud is false; the loan is NOT written off. request...accounts is the product's slot->GL-account-id mapping read back from the accepted create request create-request-LP2_ADV_PYMNT_INTEREST_DAILY_EMI_360_30_INTEREST_RECALC_DAILY_CAPITALIZED_INCOME.json: incomeFromCapitalizationAccountId 6, deferredIncomeLiabilityAccountId 23, chargeOffExpenseAccountId 14, chargeOffFraudExpenseAccountId 12, writeOffAccountId 13. expect...legs is a TRANSCRIPTION of the two L784 legs in id order from the journal-entries sweep: id 1647 entryType CREDIT glAccountId 14 amount 16.48 and id 1648 DEBIT glAccountId 23 amount 16.48. THIS VECTOR GRADES ONE PROPERTY: a charged-off non-fraud loan's amortization credits CHARGE_OFF_EXPENSE (14), not income from capitalization (6), and debits the same total to deferred income liability. It is the account cell that discriminates the ignore-loan-state drive. WHAT THIS VECTOR DOES NOT GRADE: a positive fee portion (zero here), the fraud arm (this loan is not fraud), the written-off arm, and the classification / charge-off-reason branches (not observed, no input). Nothing was computed by this promotion: every portion, account and expected leg is read directly from the committed files.
